reason: Focus probes on the Cancel button return visible false with a 0-pixel change on both accounts.custom-statement and settings.custom-statement. The cause is the date picker: it opens when From or To takes focus, stays open while Tab moves on, and its calendar covers the button (elementFromPoint at its center returns a calendar day), and Escape closes the whole dialog instead of the picker (shot:a11y/runs/2026-10-03-1525/shots/verify/verify-013/settings.custom-statement-download-focus.png). Keyboard users tab on without seeing focus, but screen-reader users are not affected and the dialog is a secondary path, so it stays medium.
